## What changes for visitors

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour. Name the base branch and any deliberately integrated unpublished work.

## Visual review

- [ ] New or substantially changed pages follow `docs/design/visual-standard.md`, use the shared `Base` layout and shared action/media components, and retain the site footer.
- [ ] `docs/design/page-review.md` records the routes/templates affected; `docs/design/route-review.json` includes each new HTML route with a useful visual choice or a reason for a text-only layout. No arbitrary image quota is applied.
- [ ] Relevant mobile/desktop before-and-after screenshots are linked. Shared changes cover home, services, Guide, contact and Timorous Beasties at 390px and 1440px; overflow/menu/dock checks cover 360, 768, 1024 and 1280px.
- [ ] Keyboard, visible focus, contrast, reduced effects, mobile footer disclosures and no-JavaScript content have been checked where affected.
- [ ] Image subjects, rights, crops, alt text, credits and intrinsic dimensions are correct. Illustrations are labelled and do not imply real project evidence, endorsement or certification.
- [ ] Existing routes, footer destinations, enquiry/shortlist/calculator behaviour, structured data and public text projections are preserved.

## Validation and limitations

List the actual commands, results and screenshot locations. Include `npm run check:visual` and relevant repository scripts. Record skipped checks and missing configuration explicitly; a skipped private-name guard is not a privacy pass. Compare performance on the same representative pages for shared visual changes. State any unresolved editorial or publication blockers. Build success does not replace visual review.
